result:
Round 184 passes and I found no bugs. Every browser check ran in real Chromium, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. This round only moves a block of shared test code (the fake audio setup) into one helper file. No app code changed, and the Studio looks pixel-for-pixel the same as in round 183.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Targeted tests | **Pass.** I ran the 3 grid test files myself: 45 of 45 passed. My list of test names, built with my own script, matches B's baseline byte for byte. The new helper file is not picked up as a test file. |
| Scope | **Pass.** The 1005 frozen files are unchanged at my start and end. Git shows only the 4 allowed edits plus the 2 new files. A hash of the whole repository was identical before and after my checks. |
| Diff review | **Pass.** The helper's body matches the original block exactly, plus only the return line. Each test file has exactly 2 changes: the import line, and the removed block replaced by one line that unpacks the helper's result. Each test file still gets its own clock and classes. Both docs are as specified. |
| Mutation evidence | **Pass.** I read A's mutation logs and checked that the helper was restored afterwards. |
| Studio rest screenshots | **Pass.** 0 changed pixels against round 183 at both 1280×720 and 1440×900. |
| Premium access | **Pass.** It is not bypassed. A fresh anonymous browser opens `/studio-lab` with no login data and no cookies. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio loaded. The studio-token request returns 401. |
| Network and errors | **Pass.** No forbidden hosts, no auth headers, no hydration or page errors. The only console errors are the expected cart errors. |
| Fake-login 403 check | **Blocked.** The backend is not available in the cloud. |

I also ran one extra pass through the real Studio flow at 1440×900. It isn't one of this round's checks:
- **Add sound and video:** I added the Middle East demo to the Music track at 2 s and a 6 s test video (an owned synthetic file) at 0 s.
- **Playback:** after 3 s the playhead and the video were in sync (2.971 s vs 2.965 s), and real audio reached the speakers.
- **Export:** the WAV is 103.352 s (2 s offset plus the 101.352 s clip), 24-bit, 48 kHz, stereo, with no broken samples.
- **Clipping:** the export has 30 samples at maximum level. The source mp3 has the same 30, so the export adds no clipping.

I deleted the 29.7 MB exported WAV after measuring it, as earlier rounds did, and kept its hash. I did not run the full test suite, verify, the build or e2e; per the speed rules those belong to root's gate.

For B:
- **Fake clock is never checked:** A's experiment of freezing the fake clock at 0 turned 0 of 45 tests red. These 3 test files never check the clock's value. Whether to add a check is B's decision; it is not A's defect.
- **73 more copies:** 73 other test files still contain their own copy of the same block. The reviewer's note about them is quoted word for word in the report. Moving them would be a separate task that needs approval.
- **Doc 152 status:** it still reads "In Progress (awaiting C round 184)" and should be changed to Completed after the gate.

There is no Ableton behaviour to compare, since this is internal test code. The report changed on disk after my last edit, outside my changes; I left that version as it is.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-184.md`
- `c-round-184.json`
- `c-browse.json`
- `c-round-184/` (screenshots, measurements, scripts)
